## About
Table Mountain Electric works out of a shop on Parfet St in Wheat Ridge and serves homes and businesses across the Denver Metro Area, from Arvada and Lakewood to Littleton, Golden and Highlands Ranch.
The work runs from outlet installation to full rewiring. That includes panel upgrades and replacements, remodel wiring for kitchens and basements, EV chargers, lighting, dedicated circuits, hot tub wiring and whole-home surge protection. Before recommending a panel or charger setup, the team evaluates your existing system and electrical load.
General contractors, builders and remodelers bring us in as their electrical subcontractor, with the same team staying on from rough-in through final trim. We keep communication clear from the first inquiry to the final walkthrough, and customers have rated us 4.9 from 495 Google reviews.

## Services
- Electrical Panel Upgrades & Replacements: Panel upgrades and replacements for homes that have outgrown their panel, with frequent breaker trips, limited breaker space, or plans for an EV charger, electric appliances or an addition.
- EV Charger Installation: Home charging installs, including a check of your electrical panel to see whether it has the capacity for the added load.
- Denver Remodeling Service: Electrical work for kitchen and basement renovations: new circuits, lighting, outlets and smoke detectors, coordinated around the rest of the remodel.
- Lighting Installation Services: Recessed and pendant lights, chandeliers, under-cabinet lighting, landscape and security lighting, and smart lighting controls, as single fixtures or part of a larger renovation.
- Hot Tub Wiring: Wiring a hot tub to the house, run in conduit and cleaned up when the job is done.
- Dedicated Circuit Installation: Circuits that serve a single high-demand appliance so it doesn't share power with everyday outlets, helping reduce overloads and nuisance breaker trips.
- Whole-Home Surge Protection: Protection at the electrical system level for electronics and appliances, a layer beyond plug-in surge strips.
- Electrical Subcontractor Services: Electrical subcontracting for basement remodels, pop-tops and second-story additions, and new home construction, with one team from rough-in through final trim.

## FAQ
Q: Do you provide free estimates?
A: Yes, for major projects. Exclusions apply for real estate and minor repairs.

Q: Are your electricians licensed and insured?
A: Yes. Our electricians are licensed and insured.

Q: Do you install backup generators?
A: Yes. We can help you choose a backup generator that meets your needs and install it so you're ready for power outages.

Q: How can I pay?
A: We accept all major credit cards and offer financing options.

Q: What areas do you serve?
A: Denver, Littleton, Lakewood, Golden, Arvada, Wheat Ridge, Centennial, Highlands Ranch and surrounding Colorado communities. If you don't see your city, call and ask.
